data.text:
Reshmi.P.R vs Vaikom Municipality on 5 July, 2024 
Wp(C) No.14112/2019 1/3 Order Date : 05
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice M.A.Abdul Hakhim
 Friday, the 5th day of July 2024 / 14th Ashadha, 1946
 Wp(C) No. 14112 Of 2019
 Petitioner:
 Reshmi.P.R., Aged 48 Years, D/O. Late P.K. Raman Pulikal, Manapuram
 P.O., Cherthala, Alappuzha. 
 Respondent:
 1. Vaikom Municipality Represented By Secretary, Municipal Office,
 Vaikom, Pin-686141.
 2. Food Safety Officer, Vaikom Circle, Thalappara, Thalayolapramabu
 P.O., Vaikom, Pin-686605. 
 3. Tahsildar, Vaikom Taluk, Vaikom, Pin-686141.
 4. Addl . R4. Ramesh Babu, Aged 53 Years, S/O. P.K.Raman,
 Puthentharayil(Ram Nivas), Near Police Quarters, Vaikom, Pin-686141. 
 5. Addl. R5.Rema.P.R., Valakkotta House,,Udayamperoor P.O., Ernakulam
 District, Pin-682307. 
 6. Addl. R6.Remya.P.R., Sreedevi Sadanam, Avalookunnu.P.O., Punnamada
 Ward, Avalookunnu, Aleppey, Pin-688006. (Additional Respondents R4
 To R6 Impleaded As Per Order Dated 02/11/2022 In Ia 2/2022. 
 Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances
 stated in the affidavit filed along with the Wp(C) the High Court be
 pleased to restraining the 1st respondent and officers under then from
 trespass and remove the structure put up by the petitioner in the property
 for which petitioner's father has got Ext.P1 patta, pending disposal of
 the Writ Petition (Civil).
 This petition coming on for orders upon perusing the petition and
 the affidavit filed in support of Wp(C) and upon hearing the arguments of
 Sri. M.S. Radhakrishnan Nair, Advocate for the petitioner, Sri. Sreekala
 A., Standing Counsel for R1, Government Pleader for R2 & R3 and of
 Sri. Dipu R., Advocate for R4 to R6, the court passed the following:
 Wp(C) No.14112/2019 2/3 Order Date
 M.A.Abdul Hakhim, J.
 -------------------------------------
 W.P.(C)No.14112 of 2019
Reshmi.P.R vs Vaikom Municipality on 5 July, 2024
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100427754/
1

 --------------------------------------
 Dated this the 5th day of July, 2024
 Order
In view of the nature of the judgment to be passed in this writ petition, I deem it appropriate to implead the District Collector, Kottayam, as additional 7th respondent in this writ petition. 
Accordingly, the District Collector, Collectorate, Kottayam - 686 002 is suo motu impleaded as an additional 7th respondent in this writ petition. 
The Registry is directed to carry out necessary changes in the cause title. 
Sd/-
M.A.ABDUL HAKHIM JUDGE Shg WP(C) No.14112/2019 3/3 Order Date : 05-07-2024 APPENDIX OF WP(C) 14112/2019 EXHIBIT P1 TRUE COPY OF THE PATTA NO.BA 593/80 DATED 12.2.1981 Reshmi.P.R vs Vaikom Municipality on 5 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100427754/
